Boasts strong metropolitan two-year-old formlines at Warwick Farm and Randwick. Maps for an ideal stalking trip under Donovan Dillon carrying 55.0kg. Rates as the standout class runner on the rise.

selections.name: Angie's Sister
selections.reason: Blistering early speed type (E) who relishes wet ground (proven soft/heavy form). Fitter for recent sprinting runs, including a close third over 800m at Gilgandra and strong performances at Scone and Wellington. Carries featherweight 55.0kg and will cross fast to contest the lead on the short home turn.

selections.name: Haney
selections.reason: Sensational four-length romp second-up over 950m at Moree following an excellent first-up runner-up effort at this exact track and trip. In career-best form for Sue Grills, handles the sting out of the ground, and has tactical speed (P) to offset the wide gate.

selections.name: Miss Mercy
selections.reason: Course-and-distance winner over 1000m on soft ground at Tamworth two starts ago before finishing a close-up fourth in a 14-horse field at Gunnedah. Jake Pracey-Holmes retains the ride; gets a great midfield stalking run from barrier 5 carrying 55.5kg.

selections.name: Maxandus
selections.reason: Consistent short-course galloper from the Melissa Dennett stable with Rory Hutchings aboard. Box-seated and was only beaten 0.8 lengths over this track and distance in BM58 grade last start. Inside draw (barrier 4) grants +2 inside sprint bonus.
